title: Polished responsive landing page and app shell

scope.summary: A polished, responsive public landing page at / for Shared Reading Lists and the app shell (header with the product name and primary navigation, main content area, footer) used by all pages.

interface.landing: GET / (signed out): exactly one h1 containing the text "Shared Reading Lists"; a link with accessible name "Sign up" to /signup and a link with accessible name "Sign in" to /login (those pages arrive in T2).

criteria.statement: The landing page and app shell look polished and trustworthy, communicate what Shared Reading Lists does (create reading lists, add books, share them read-only) and work well at phone, tablet and desktop widths.
refs: owner judgment at 375, 768 and 1280 px -> locked visual baselines baselines/T1/*

criteria.metric: axe-core violations with impact serious or critical (WCAG 2.1 A/AA rule tags)

criteria.conditions: preview in CI, Chromium, 375x812 viewport, 4x CPU throttling, no network throttling

criteria.then: no horizontal overflow (document scroll width <= viewport width), exactly one h1 containing "Shared Reading Lists", visible links "Sign up" (to /signup) and "Sign in" (to /login)
